stem: Both the author of the selection “A Legacy of Stone” and the author of the selection “Trees Rise in the Desert” would most likely agree with which statement?

options.label: F
options.text: The work of one person can have far-reaching effects.

options.label: G
options.text: People must protect the world surrounding them.

options.label: H
options.text: Old traditions may offer surprising wisdom.

options.label: J
options.text: People can use their talents to invent something new.
